about.text: A small cow's-milk cheese from the Sorrento peninsula in Campania, shaped in rush baskets (canestri) that give it its name. The milk is heated to 36 to 37 °C and set with rennet, and the curd is drained in the baskets to dry before being wrapped in parchment.
